title: Deep High-Resolution Representation Learning for Visual Recognition (HRNet)
mechanism: Parallel high-to-low resolution streams with repeated multi-resolution exchange keep a 1/4 stream through the whole network.
adaptation: HRNet-W18/W32 ImageNet as encoder under PF; top stream is 1/4, so add a stride-1 stem skip; 1-ch input replicated.
min_experiment: Arm: HRNet-W32 + stem skip (PF); baseline: house PF; CV crack IoU, inactive IoU, gridline IoU. Kill if all n.d.
evidence: R: shown superior on pose, segmentation, detection (Cityscapes etc.); no thin-line data.
prior_overlap: Backbone row tested ResNet-50 only; R5 partly covers resolution. HRNet itself open.

alt_notes.adaptation: HRNet-W18/W32 (timm, ImageNet) under PF plus a stride-1 stem skip; OCR head because 99% of inactive regions touch a crack, so per-cell crack-region descriptors are useful context for inactive.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm HRNet-W32-OCR vs house PF; 5-fold CV crack IoU, inactive IoU, mIoU_rob; kill: no metric above detection floor (crack 0.012) and inactive n.d. About 15 GPU-h.
